title: Part Time Adjunct Faculty - Nursing
description:
Instructional faculty report to the Department Chair overseeing the course/content area they are teaching. This is a remote online part-time faculty position based within the continental United States.
Excelsior University provides fully developed courses with materials and activities to allow the faculty to focus on the students. Part-time faculty should expect to provide prompt and substantive responses to student needs, hold virtual office hours, assist in proctoring if applicable, offer timely formative feedback on student work, and demonstrate their subject matter expertise through constructive involvement with student discussions and learning activities. In addition, Excelsior looks for our instructional faculty to demonstrate a commitment to student success by supporting college engagement and retention initiatives, reaching out to struggling students and collaborating with faculty and support staff to ensure students have access to all available resources that impact success.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Implementing courses as designed by the University.

• Bring individual knowledge and expertise on the subject matter in the engagement of students.

• Hold regular virtual office hours, weekly.

• Participate in ATI proctoring if applicable.

• Keep the department chair apprised of any student or course issues.

• Follow University policies.

• Complete University-required training and attending required pre-term meetings.

• Respond to all messages from students and the University within 48 hours.

• Utilize provided rubrics to grade all assignments timely and provide narrative feedback that summarizes the strengths and areas in need of improvement.

• Cultivate a caring environment that supports open dialogue, collaboration, and opportunities for scholarly growth.

• Enforce all University policies listed in the Faculty Handbook.

• Submit final grades timely, within 3 days after the end of the term.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Earned doctoral or terminal degree in Nursing or related field from a regionally accredited institution.

• New York Registered Nurse licensure or the willingness to apply for New York state licensure.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to present information clearly, concisely, and accurately; friendly, persuasive speaking and writing style.

• Experience in Nursing Education in areas such as teaching-learning strategies, educational technologies, writing course and module outcomes, curriculum design, assessment and evaluation strategies, and research, etc.

Rate of Pay:

• A flat rate of $1000 per credit for a section of at least 10 undergraduate students or 8 graduate students. Courses that fall under these student headcounts are considered low enrolled courses.

• Low enrolled courses will be paid on a directed study rate ($250/student for undergraduate courses and $300/student for graduate courses) based on the number of students enrolled in the course section at the close of late registration.

Remote applicants please be aware that the University is required to withhold New York state income taxes from your wages, as well as the state income tax, if applicable, in the state where you perform services. This is because of New York’s “convenience of the employer” rule, which requires the University, as a New York employer, to withhold New York income tax from the wages of its employees working outside of New York if the employee’s work is performed outside of New York for the convenience

title: Staff QA Software Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based at our Santa Clara, CA office, with the option to work a few days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 15%, domestic or international.
Job ID: 1913 

The Role: 

We're hiring a QA Engineer to own quality for our SaaS-based Quantum Security Posture Management platform. This role is focused on rigorous, product-level testing - functional correctness, regression coverage, and automation - for a platform that models Layer 2/Layer 3 networks and evaluates security posture. You'll work closely with developers to catch defects early and build confidence in every release.

Responsibilities :

• Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for platform features: network discovery, topology mapping, policy/rule analysis, posture scoring, alerting, and reporting.

• Perform functional, regression, integration, and API testing across releases and sprints.

• Validate correctness of Layer 2/Layer 3 network modeling (VLANs, routing, ACLs, NAT, firewall rules) as represented and analyzed by the product.

• Build and maintain automated test suites (UI and API level - Selinium, REST Assured, Pytest) to increase regression coverage and reduce manual testing effort.

• Set up and maintain test environments/labs, including virtual network topologies (e.g., GNS3, EVE-NG, containerlab) and multi-vendor device configs (Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet).

• Log, triage, and track defects; work with engineering to reproduce, root-cause, and verify fixes.

• Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and release readiness reviews, providing a quality/risk perspective.

• Contribute to test strategy improvements, including shift-left testing practices and CI/CD test integration.

• Maintain clear, thorough test documentation (test cases, coverage matrices, defect reports).

Requirements:

• 10+ years of experience in software QA/testing, ideally for SaaS or enterprise infrastructure products.

• Working knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking (VLANs, subnetting, routing protocols, ACLs, NAT, firewall logic).

• Foundational security knowledge - firewall policies, segmentation, common vulnerabilities/misconfigurations.

• Experience with manual and automated testing (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman) and defect tracking tools (Jira, etc.).

• Comfortable testing REST APIs and validating JSON/data payloads.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Scripting experience (Python, Bash) for test automation.

• Experience with virtual network labs (GNS3, EVE-NG) or cloud networking (AWS VPC, Azure VNet).

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and test integration.

• Certifications such as ISTQB, CCNA, or Security+.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit option

title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril's UK operations are scaling rapidly, with a growing portfolio of defence technology programmes and an expanding international footprint across Europe and the Middle East. The Finance & Accounting team sits at the centre of this growth - partnering with programme teams, engineering, and business development to deliver financial rigour, while simultaneously building the regional finance infrastructure that will underpin Anduril's long-term international success.

This is a new role created to bridge two critical requirements: hands-on programme finance across a live portfolio of contracted customer work, and the ground-up build of a regional finance capability that does not exist today.

About the Job

This role has two pillars, and the balance between them will flex with business demand.

The first is programme finance. You will own the financial planning and analysis for a portfolio of contracted customer programmes and internal R&D activities within the Air Maneuver business line. This will include day-to-day forecasting, Estimate at Completion (EAC) maintenance, actuals analysis, variance reporting, bid pricing, and business case support across UK and European campaigns.

The second is regional finance maturity. You will help build the internal management reporting process for the UK, Europe, and Middle East region from scratch - establishing KPIs, creating a monthly close cadence, producing performance narratives for leadership, and putting the systems, controls, and automation in place to make it repeatable and scalable.

This is not a role where you inherit a playbook or sit within a large established team. You will be creating structure, defining processes, and shaping how finance operates in a fast-growing defence technology company. If you want ownership, breadth, and the chance to build something from nothing, this is it.

What You Will Do

• Own day-to-day programme finance across a portfolio of contracted customer programmes - EAC maintenance, actuals analysis, variance narrative, and monthly financial reporting.

• Be an effective finance business partner to cross-functional programme teams.

• Build and maintain programme forecast models and support the divisional forecast cycle.

• Support financial activities for UK-specific IRAD (Internal Research & Development) programmes.

• Build and operate the regional internal management P&L reporting process from scratch, covering UK, Europe, and the Middle East. Establish the monthly close and associated reporting timetable.

• Define and maintain regional performance KPIs. Produce the first-draft performance narrative each period - actuals, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions - bringing P&L and balance sheet views together with base case, upside, and downside scenarios.

• Own the monthly data pulls from Foundry and Oracle EPM. Build the controls and automation that make the reporting cycle repeatable rather than manual. Reconcile management reporting back to the statutory ledger and document the process and its controls as it is built.

• Interface with international accounting managers on statutory, tax, and audit requirements. Support the UK leadership team and Global Defence & Growth Operations.

title: Staff ML Performance Engineer

title: Product Engineer, Manufacturing & Supply Chain
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

- Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

- Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

ROLE SCOPE

- Turn the bill of materials into the order book: every template bill carries the price and lead time of each line, every project bill locks against a building, and every purchase order derives from it, so tens of billions of dollars of GPUs, optics, switchgear, and cooling are ordered from one source of truth instead of a spreadsheet.

- Make procurement tracking trustworthy: the rules that decide when a line is late, what its status means, and which lines sit on the critical path run in code against live vendor emails, documents, and general contractor purchase orders through the extractors you ship, so drift is caught the week it happens and the recovery plan is drafted before the vendor calls.

- Close the loop from receiving to payment: every delivery matches a purchase order line, every warehouse bin knows its serial numbers, cycle counts are scored against an accuracy gate, and finance three-way matches from the same record, so the question "did we get what we paid for" has one answer instead of three.

- Ship manufacturing as software before the factory opens: manufacturing bills of materials, engineering change notices, and the drawing tree live in one model, inspection and test plans and first article procedures generate per asset from the design revision, and a failed check opens a nonconformance with the evidence attached and rescores the vendor.

- Embed with sourcing leads, quality managers, factory operators, and warehouse teams, on their floors and in their vendor calls, and turn their judgment into the systems that decide the order schedule, the cash demand by month, and the payment schedule the company plans against.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Chief of Staff is part of the senior leadership team of the Vinted-wide Data Science & Analytics function. Your primary role will be to build an aligned, engaged, and impactful team while ensuring the successful management and execution of key data strategies and initiatives. The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Vice President of Data Science & Analytics (“VP of DSA”) and acts as a trusted advisor and partner in ensuring that the department runs smoothly, efficiently, and effectively.

This is a fixed-term (maternity cover) position for approximately 1 year.

In this position, you’ll 

• Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP of DSA, providing advice and guidance on all matters within the function (e.g. operating cadence, planning, problem analysis, communication). 

• Own and run the function’s reporting cycles end-to-end (e.g. QBRs, OKR meetings, DSA All Hands); including content creation, preparation, facilitation, and follow-ups.

• Be responsible for coordinating the development and driving the execution of key function strategies and initiatives  (e.g. data related initiatives that drive long-term impact), and supporting broader cross-functional and organisational initiatives that involve DSA (e.g. reorganisations and operating model shifts).

• Oversee and manage recurrent DSA operations (e.g. DSA’s onboarding programme as well as the Data Science & Analytics Academy programme).

• Own the delivery of key functional events, including planning groups and agenda development (e.g. offsites, function week).

• Be accountable for maintaining an efficient operating model by ensuring processes, policies, and ceremonies are in place and effective, fostering an aligned, engaged, and impactful team.

• Support the DSA leadership team on the integration of AI into our data team’s (300+ team members) workflows.

• Be the driving force behind the senior and extended DSA leadership teams; coordinating and managing meetings, keeping track of decisions and pending relevant actions, holding the group accountable, and ensuring follow-through.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Dependability Team

Our Product Dependability team connects Wayve’s embodied AI technology with the demands of real-world automotive products. Working across systems engineering, safety, cybersecurity and data analysis, the team helps translate AI capabilities into dependable vehicle-level behavior and supports integration with our OEM partners.

Wayve is developing driver-out Robotaxi systems that bring together the AI Driver, vehicle platform, sensors and compute, safety mechanisms, Remote Assistance, fleet services and cloud operations. As a Systems Engineer, Robotaxi, you’ll work closely alongside our lead Robotaxi System Architect, translating their reference architecture into clear, implementable functions, requirements, interfaces and verification-ready outputs for the areas you own.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Own systems engineering for defined parts of the Robotaxi architecture, translating use cases, operational concepts and constraints into requirements, interfaces, assumptions and verification-ready specifications.

- Work directly with OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers and Robotaxi operators to define system and product boundaries together, leading technical working sessions and design discussions.

- Support implementation through technical reviews, bring-up planning, issue triage and design-change impact analysis, escalating cross-domain or cross-program tradeoffs beyond your scope to the lead architect and relevant domain owners.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

Your scope covers how the Robotaxi system works as a safe, scalable driver-out service-from the vehicle, Automated Driving System (ADS) and onboard compute to offboard capabilities and the boundaries between Wayve and our partners.

You’ll apply the Robotaxi reference architecture to real vehicle programs across sensors, compute, ECU topology, vehicle interfaces and degraded-operation behavior. Depending on your defined scope, this could include vehicle/ADS interfaces, Remote Assistance and offboard boundaries, or fleet and cloud integration.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have direct, hands-on experience designing, integrating or deploying a Robotaxi or production-intent L4 driver-out system, with systems engineering experience spanning several domains across hardware, embedded software, autonomy, safety, offboard services or operations.

- You can turn use cases and operational concepts into functional decomposition, requirements, interfaces, assumptions, trade studies and verification intent, producing artifacts that teams can implement and verify.

- You’ve defined system and product boundaries across organizations, working directly with OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, operators or technology partners while maintaining clear internal ownership.

- You’re comfortable owning a defined scope within a larger reference architecture, partnering with a lead architect and communicating complex designs clearly through documents, diagrams, requirements and technical reviews.

- Robotaxi launch readiness and operations, including fleet services, Remote Assistance, teleoperation, depot operations, passenger systems or monitoring.

description: Über uns Kijimea - Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. title: Engineering Manager - Inference Performance
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead part of our Inference Performance team. This team makes the world's most demanding AI workloads run faster and more efficiently on GPUs. You'll manage and grow a team of inference performance engineers working across the inference engine and runtime: kernels, scheduling, batching, KV-cache management, speculative decoding and prefill/decode disaggregation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set direction, unblock hard problems and earn the team's trust by going deep on GPU performance, while also hiring, developing and supporting the people doing the work. Your team's output directly affects how fast our customers' models run and how efficiently we serve them. The team is scaling quickly, so you'll help shape how it is structured as it grows.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- Agentic inference optimization: 50-90% faster engines https://www.baseten.co/blog/agentic-inference-optimization-faster-than-sota/

- Set high standards for engineering quality, benchmarking, operational excellence and incident response.

title: Senior, ML Engineer - VLM
description:
About the Company
At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.
Meet The Team
Torc is marching toward its AV 3.0 strategy, where end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perceive, reason, and act directly from sensor data. High-quality, semantically rich training data is the single biggest lever for that strategy, and this team owns it.
Sitting within Offline Perception, this team turns petabytes of logged multi-modal fleet data (images, kinematics) into VLM/VLA-ready datasets: geometric annotations, scenario-level semantic descriptions, action- and trajectory-grounded labels, and reasoning traces that explain why a maneuver was taken. We run a continuous data flywheel - mine long-tail and failure cases, auto-label at scale, validate quality, and feed curated datasets directly into Torc’s end-to-end VLM/VLA model development. You will own the dataset layer that those models learn from.
What You’ll Do

•
Own the offline dataset pipeline - design, implement, test, and deploy Cloud-based pipelines that convert logged multi-sensor data into VLM/VLA training datasets, spanning geometric labels (3D/2D detection, tracking, segmentation, depth) through semantic, scenario-level, and action/trajectory-grounded annotations.

•
Build VLM-assisted auto-labeling - develop open-vocabulary detection, dense captioning, semantic enrichment, and scene/scenario description generation that move beyond closed-set bounding boxes, using foundation models to scale annotation and cut manual labeling cost.

•
Generate reasoning-grounded labels - produce language-grounded reasoning and chain-of-causation style annotations, temporally aligned to ego-motion and trajectories, to support VLA training and explainable driving behavior.

•
Mine and curate the long tail - surface rare, difficult, and high-uncertainty scenarios, and build curated datasets that measurably improve downstream VLM/VLA model metrics rather than simply adding volume.

•
Close the data flywheel - define dataset schemas, quality metrics, and validation; track auto-labeling quality against model requirements; route model failures back into re-labeling and retraining loops.

•
Partner with the end-to-end model team - co-define dataset specifications with VLM/VLA model developers, own the quality bar and delivery cadence, and operationalize a continuous dataset delivery loop into their training pipelines.

•
Scale on cloud infrastructure - build distributed, reproducible pipelines using columnar data formats and distributed compute, with disciplined software practices, version control, and documentation.

•
Lead and mentor - serve as project lead, guide less-experienced engineers, run design reviews, set coding and annotation standards, and drive alignment across team interfaces to the rest of the organization.

•
Stay current - track the latest advances in multimodal models, auto-labeling, and end-to-end autonomous driving, and translate relevant research into production data systems.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

•
Considered highly skilled and proficient in discipline ; conducts complex, important work under minimal supervision and with wide latitude for independent judgment.

•
Scope of Influence: Expected to drive alignment across team interfaces to the rest of the organization. Designs, maintains, and owns team technical solutions and drives consensus. Mentors and guides engineers within the group.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Robo

Most companies make you choose: build the platform, or go deploy it. Here you do both - and that's the point.

Afresh leads the customer relationship and direction; you and a small team bring the technical firepower - scope and architect the work with the customer, then build it. Because you also own the platform underneath, the rough edges you hit in the field become the things you fix at the root.

• Build the evals, tracing, and tooling that let the team measure quality - accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost - and ship faster on the next customer.

• Build for leverage: clean interfaces and reusable building blocks, not one-off per-customer code.

Across both

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Principal Engineer for our New York office, which opened this summer. You'll work alongside our other principals to set technical direction for the company.

We're defining what AI-first product development looks like in practice: the UI/UX, the capabilities, the data models, and the systems underneath them. It's a wide open problem space, and you'll be one of the people deciding which problems matter most and how we solve them.

In practice, that means you'll:

- Set technical direction. Own the architecture for major parts of our product and make the calls that shape the platform for years to come - then write the code to back them up.

- Take on our hardest problems. The ambiguous, high-stakes, cross-cutting work: reliability at millions-of-tickets scale, evaluation and quality systems for AI agents, and the foundations other engineers build on.

- Define how we build with AI. Coding agents are a core part of our workflow. You'll design the tooling, guardrails, and feedback loops that make them effective across the team - and bring the judgment to know when output is ready to ship and when it isn't.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend most of your time building, and you'll lead through the quality of your thinking and your work rather than through a reporting line.

Our stack is TypeScript, React/Remix, PrismaORM, NestJS, and some Python. Knowledge of the stack is nice; we know great engineers pick things up fast.

 

WE'D LOVE TO TALK IF YOU

- Have 10+ years of experience shipping software, including time as a staff- or principal-level engineer at a company with high engineering standards

- Have set the technical direction for a product or platform and lived with the consequences - you can tell us what you'd do differently

- Have led ambiguous, high-stakes projects from blank page to production, across the stack

- Make other engineers better through design reviews, mentorship, and the example you set in your own code

- Use coding agents as a core part of how you build - not just as autocomplete, but as a real development workflow - and have opinions on how teams should use them

- Want to be early: real scope, real ownership, and real upside at a fast-moving company

WHAT'S UNIQUE ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY?

A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it - because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company - not just execute

title: Head of B2C Growth
description:
Who we are
Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak.
Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute.
About the job
You own B2C growth end to end. You bring buyers and renters to Properstar . You keep them coming back. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it.
That means multichannel acquisition and a lifecycle that runs from first visit to repeat visit. Search, paid social, email, push, app. The app comes first.
One gap matters most. People start with research: what a flat costs in Lisbon, how to rent in Spain as a foreigner. Later, they search for a home. Today we don't connect the two. You build that bridge.
2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it, with a large paid push in France, Spain, and Switzerland.
You own the budget and direct our paid media specialists. You report to the CPO.
What you'll do

• Set the growth strategy. Channels, markets, segments, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.

• Build multichannel acquisition. Test new channels, scale what works. Know your CPL, CAC, and payback by channel and market.

• Connect research to search. Turn people reading guides and asking questions into people searching listings and contacting agents.

• Make the app our first channel. Installs, adoption, retention. Move users from web to app and keep them there.

• Own the lifecycle. Activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, LTV. Find where users drop and fix it.

• Work the database. Segment, nurture, reactivate. Email, push, in-app.

• Run experiments. Landing pages, onboarding, messaging, offers. Fast cycles, clear reads.

• Direct the specialists. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.

• Work with product and nurturing. Push for what moves conversion. Track lead qualification with our nurturing lead.

• Prepare the 2028 ramp-up. Markets, channels, creative, tracking. Ready before we spend.

• Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.

• Talk to users. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

•
Growth track record. You've grown a B2C product with a large user base, across channels and markets. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. Marketplace, portal, or app experience is a strong plus.

•
Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel ads specialists won't fit.

•
App growth. You've driven installs and, more importantly, retention. You know what makes people open an app twice.

•
Database mindset. You think in cohorts and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest user is the one you already have.

•
Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.

•
Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a paid budget and answered for the return. You set up the campaign and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.

•
Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar.

•
Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test.

•
Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs.

•
Leadership. You make specialists better and faster without micromanaging them.

•
Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.

•
Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

• Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required

title: Software Engineer, Research Tooling
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the Research Tools team, you'll build the infrastructure and applications that enable our researchers to iterate quickly, run complex experiments, and extract insights. This is a full-stack product-engineering role.

You'll work directly with researchers and engineers to deeply understand their workflows, identify bottlenecks, and rapidly ship solutions that multiply their productivity. Whether you're creating platforms for experiment orchestration, developing novel visualization tools for model evaluation, or building abstractions for understanding model behavior at scale, your work will directly accelerate our mission of building frontier AI models.

We're looking for someone who can jump into new problems, quickly develop domain expertise, and independently drive impactful projects from conception to delivery. No prior ML or research experience is required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and maintain the full-stack applications and infrastructure researchers rely on daily, covering experiment setup, feedback collection, and results analysis.

- Own complete product areas from user needs through design, implementation, and iteration, setting standards for how to build research applications.

- Create reusable platforms and tools that speed up new research applications, then prototype, ship, and iterate quickly based on real-world usage.

- Partner with research teams to turn their workflows and pain points into intuitive interfaces and abstractions that make complex research tasks fast and approachable.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You’ve had experience building tools, platforms, or infrastructure for technical users (engineers, researchers, data scientists, analysts, etc.)

- You’ve shipped full-stack products and owned systems from user interface to storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.

- You’ve built dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards-and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.

- You have strong product instincts, can identify the right problems to solve, and can move from concept to working prototype with ease.

- You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.

Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful.

• Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks.

• Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings.

• Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves.

• Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks.

• Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems.

• The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly.

• An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists.

• For the Research Scientist profile: evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas.

• For the Research Engineer profile: evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation.

Bonus Points For

• Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research.

• Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments.

Medicheck hjälper patienter över hela landet och vår affärsidé är att det ska vara enkelt för en patient att komma i kontakt med en specialist som kan utreda, följa upp och vid behov hitta nya behandlingar för patientens individuella behov. • End-to-End Incident Response: Proven experience managing security incidents throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial alert investigation and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of Kubernetes and container security principles, including common risks and security considerations in containerized environments

title: Audio Production Expert (Contract)
description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

About the role

Most voices in Cartesia’s library starts as a recording. We’re looking for someone who has spent years making those recordings great from a technical standpoint, and have the ears to understand what good sounds like.

You’ll own voice production production from spec definition, to recoding pre-processing, to final delivery. You’ll also take customer requests from our Voices team and quickly generate the voices to the required fidelity, timeline, and requirements.

This is an internal role and not client facing. Voices team brings the requirements to you. You’ll work day to day with our Voice Production Lead, who owns the creative and customer side, while you own the technical side and set the bar for what good audio means at Cartesia.

What you’ll do

- Set casting requirements and review recordings. Define what we need from voice actors, and be the first to evaluate raw recordings as they come in.

- Produce voices from recordings. Use your audio engineering and voice knowledge to turn raw recordings into high-quality voices.

- Turn customer requests into voices. Take a brief like “warm, trustworthy, a little Southern, for a healthcare line” and deliver a voice that fits it.

- Build our audio and voice IP. Develop the specs, workflows, and know-how that make great voices repeatable at Cartesia.

- Support Research and Data. Help with audio for TTS and ASR needs

Your first 30 days

- Day 1: You have end-to-end understanding of our voice pipeline, as well as heuristics for creating good voices

- Day 5: You’ve BAU in shipping voices for the team. Given a raw dataset, you produce voices, within a pre-defined SLA

- Day 30: You ship systems to scale the efforts, and develop in-house IP on creating ideal recordings.

What we’re looking for

- Deep command of audio fundamentals and the technical details: recording, editing, processing, mastering, and delivery specs.

- Strong grasp of voice fundamentals. You can describe a voice in precise, nuanced terms (pitch, timbre, pace, intonation, room sound) to any stakeholder, technical or not.

- You use tools like Claude Code to automate the repetitive work and get things done fast.

- A great communicator: clear, direct, and easy to work with.

Nice to have

- Experience with text-to-speech, speech recognition, voice cloning, or speech datasets.

- Directing in multiple languages or accents.

- Basic scripting (Python, ffmpeg, SoX) for batch work.

How we hire

1. 30-minute call with our recruiting team.

2. Take-home (2-3 hours): build a set of voices from raw, multi-speaker call recordings using Cartesia’s Instant Voice Cloning, and write up your processing and choices.

3. Live listening review (45-60 minutes): we play your voices together and talk through what you heard, what you did, and what you’d change.

You will work with senior engineers, customer executives and our sales team, and lead multicultural teams in a matrix organisation. Beyond your own projects, you will help strengthen our European delivery model. Your Impact
What you'll do

Plan and deliver

• Build and run project plans aligned to contractual commitments, with clear milestones for delivery, invoicing and resourcing.

• Manage risks and issues proactively, with mitigation plans tailored to each project.

• Set and enforce quality standards through regular project reviews.

• Lead formal project closure: final reviews, lessons learned and a clean handover to support.

Own the numbers

• Manage budgets, forecasts and financial reporting, including revenue recognition and milestone billing.

• Control costs and allocate resources to protect margin.

• Spot change requests and follow-on opportunities, and work with sales to pursue them.

Lead people and stakeholders

• Lead and mentor multicultural project teams across a matrix organisation.

• Build trusted relationships with customer sponsors and internal stakeholders.

• Report progress, risks and decisions clearly to executives and sponsors.

• Use customer feedback and survey results to raise satisfaction.

Improve how we deliver

• Help define and embed the European delivery model and governance standards.

• Remove bottlenecks and share lessons learned across projects.

• Support pre-sales with proposal, deal and contract reviews, focusing on scope, risk and commercial terms.

What You'll Need
What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field.

• 8+ years managing complex, large-scale projects, ideally software or systems delivery in the power utilities sector.

• Solid knowledge of at least two of: generation, transmission, distribution.

• A track record of full P&L accountability for customer projects: budgets, forecasts, milestone billing and change control.

• Experience leading multicultural technical teams in a matrix organisation.

• Confidence with both senior engineers and customer executives; you handle conflict calmly and negotiate well.

• Strong commercial sense and structured problem-solving.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

• Willingness to travel across Europe 25-75% of the time, depending on project phase.

Nice to have

• Master's degree in a relevant field.

• PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification.

• Hands-on experience with EMS, SCADA, ADMS or similar control-room systems.

• Dutch or German; another European language is also valued.

title: Claims Team Lead - Cargo
description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role

• As a Team Lead at Reserv , you will be a working leader providing support to a Claims manager with leadership and claim technical responsibilities. Leadership responsibilities will include overseeing work done within the Commercial Transportation Cargo Claims adjusting staff. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. This role will balance management responsibilities and individual contributor responsibilities when volume dictates the need for assistance with a claim.

What you'll do

• We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

• Flexibility - you will need to be able to switch from claims handling to coaching and feedback

• Agility- you must have an agile mindset and the ability to pivot from focus to focus in a moment’s notice

• Be consistently dependable in achieving or exceeding goals and overcoming obstacles

• Implement and maintain best practices for claims handling, including claim intake, investigation, evaluation, settlement, and recovery

• Align team with client and customer expectations of the claims process

• Serve as a resource for escalated claims

• Foster a positive work environment, promote teamwork, and encourage professional growth and development

• Attract, hire, retain, and provide a high level of training with the support of the rest of the leadership team

• Prepare and present comprehensive claims reports, metrics, and analyses to clients and customers; advise clients on claim trends and loss mitigation

Job Duties:

• Serve as backup/leader when the Manager is out of office

• Responsible for having direct reports

• Responsible for initial onboarding tasks/ access and new hire cultural immersion

• SME for first-line questions, escalations, roundtable discussions

• Increased reserve and payment authority with the ability to assist with moderate reviews

• Identify topics and trends to discuss in team Huddles and Elevated Claims Experience Workshops lead/ co-lead by Team Leads, Managers, and other Reserv employees

• Customer Obsession Champions- Active advocates who help leadership cultivate a customer-centric mindset

Qualifications

• 5+ years of insurance claims experience in multiple lines of business, preference for an cargo claims or inland marine with some bodily injury experience

• 3+ years of leadership experience with a preference for experience managing in a remote environment

• Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license

• Comfortable with technology and the ability to evolve the claims systems and processes to drive better efficiencies and outcomes

• Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and attention to detail

• Integrity, ethics, and a strong sense of accountability in handling confidential and sensitive information

Benefits

• Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental

• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching

• Competitive PTO policy - we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy,

Remote, United States
This position requires an active Public Trust clearance.
Position Summary:
Criterion Systems LLC is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Service Recovery) to support its Cybersecurity Oversight and Compliance Team and the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF). This role supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of business contingency and IT service recovery plans that help NSF sustain operations during disruptive events and recover quickly. The analyst will work with federal and contractor staff across IT operations, application development, cybersecurity policy, risk management, and service recovery, as well as other NSF stakeholders. The position requires expertise in disaster recovery, risk management, and actionable contingency strategies.

Highlights include:

• Conduct risk assessments and business impact analyses to identify vulnerabilities and establish mitigation strategies.

• Design service recovery procedures and define recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs) for key systems and services.

• Coordinate with NSF directorates, offices, and branches to integrate IT continuity and recovery into agency preparedness efforts.

• Maintain contingency and recovery documentation and provide leadership with regular status updates.

• Stay current on continuity, IT, and cybersecurity practices and federal guidance.

• Develop and deliver training so staff understand their recovery responsibilities.

• Recommend improvements to contingency planning based on changes in technology, business needs, regulations, incidents, and exercises.

• Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

No supervisory/management authority
